about: The prayer recalls the new sacred company of virgins God willed to flourish through Angela Merici in His Church. It asks, through her intercession, for angelic conduct and worthiness to enjoy eternal joys fully after renouncing all earthly things.

seg.tr: God, You willed a new sacred company of virgins to flourish in Your Church through blessed Angela. Grant that, through her intercession, we may live in angelic ways, so that, having renounced all earthly things, we may be worthy to enjoy eternal joys to the full. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we may be worthy to enjoy eternal joys fully

ex.w006: The source heading names Angela Merici. The prayer says that God acted through her, without giving an institutional foundation date or a formal name for the company.
ex.w009: New and sacred both qualify the company of virgins. The company is what God willed to flourish in His Church.
ex.w017: Her refers to Angela. The form eius does not by itself distinguish masculine from feminine reference.
ex.w019: Angelic describes the way the community asks to live. It does not ask that human beings change their nature into angels.
ex.w025: Renouncing all earthly things is prior to the desired enjoyment of eternal joys. The phrase does not independently claim that this renunciation was already complete before the present prayer.
ex.w028: The community asks to be worthy to enjoy eternal joys fully. Neither mereamur nor perfrui states that the desired enjoyment has already been earned or achieved.
